claim_boundary: Retrospective achieved-precision and minimum-resolvable risk-difference derivation over the checksum-pinned #5351 successor rows. This is a design-sensitivity diagnostic, NOT a post-hoc observed-data adequacy computation, NOT prospective sizing, and NOT a claim that 30 seeds were adequate for any target effect. Output remains blocked_review_pending and promotes no benchmark, paper, or dissertation claim automatically.

claim_gate.reason: retrospective precision derivation over frozen #5351 rows; claim promotion requires human review

estimand.description: Paired risk difference in binary outcome rates between two planner arms on matched scenario-seed cells

exclusions.reason: The cluster bootstrap percentile interval is not validated for event rates near zero; contrasts where both arms have near-zero event rates produce degenerate intervals that cannot support precision claims
The 35 scenario families are the resampling unit, not a random sample from a super-population; precision statements apply to these specific families, not to unseen scenario types
Within-family correlation is preserved by the cluster bootstrap; treating individual cells as independent would artificially narrow intervals and overstate precision
The 30 seeds per scenario were not chosen via a prospective sizing calculation for any specific target effect; the MRRD is a retrospective design-sensitivity measure, not a prospective adequacy claim

mrrd_contract.contrast_reported_value: mrrd_practical_observed_direction, selected by the sign of observed_risk_difference; both signed tails are retained
mrrd_contract.negative_direction: Smallest delta >= 0 whose shifted equal-tailed upper percentile bound is <= -min_risk_difference
mrrd_contract.positive_direction: Smallest delta >= 0 whose shifted equal-tailed lower percentile bound is >= +min_risk_difference
mrrd_contract.practical_normal_approximation: For either sign, min_risk_difference + z_(1-alpha/2) * bootstrap_se
mrrd_contract.sensitivity_reported_value: mrrd_practical_worst_case, the larger signed tail because the synthetic null sensitivity rows have no observed effect direction

multiplicity.inference: exact two-sided McNemar test on matched binary outcomes
multiplicity.note: Holm step-down correction is applied to the exact two-sided McNemar p-values for all exposed contrasts, matching the admitted #5351 multiplicity policy. The descriptive percentile precision intervals and MRRDs are reported without multiplicity adjustment; these decisions do not alter those values.

practical_effect_rule.description: A signed risk difference is practically separable only when its interval clears the corresponding positive or negative threshold; effects with magnitude below min_risk_difference are treated as practically null even when their interval excludes zero

proposed_dissertation_statement: [blocked_review_pending] Retrospective achieved-precision derivation over the frozen 0.0.3.post1 successor rows (n=1440 matched cells per planner pair, one-stage scenario-family cluster bootstrap with n=35 families, 95% equal-tailed percentile intervals, B=2000 resamples). Achieved collision CI widths range from 0.1663 (hybrid_rule_v3_fast_progress_static_escape_continuous vs orca) to 0.3297 (social_force vs orca). The minimum resolvable risk difference under the declared practical-effect threshold (>= 0.02) ranges from 0.1012 to 0.1790 across headline contrasts, using the observed RD direction: positive effects use the lower tail and negative effects use the upper tail. This is a design-sensitivity measure, NOT a post-hoc observed-data adequacy computation, and does NOT claim prospective adequacy of the 30-seed design. Multiplicity inference uses exact two-sided McNemar p-values with Holm step-down over 39 exposed contrasts; the descriptive precision intervals and MRRDs are not multiplicity-adjusted. Material exclusions: rare-event degeneracy, family-generalization beyond the 35 observed families, and non-independent cell interpretation. Claim promotion requires separate human review.

sensitivity_model.interpretation: synthetic design-sensitivity calibration, not observed evidence
sensitivity_model.outcome_generation: independent Bernoulli null arms at each baseline event rate

terminology_note: This report uses 'achieved precision' (CI width) and 'minimum resolvable risk difference' (MRRD, a signed-tail-aware design-sensitivity measure). Positive and negative practical MRRDs use opposite CI tails, and contrast rows report the tail matching the observed RD direction. It does NOT report any post-hoc observed-data adequacy metric, does NOT claim prospective adequacy, and does NOT claim that the 30-seed design was chosen via a prospective sizing calculation.
